document: Senior Fullstack Developer at Inscripta (May 2019 - December 2021). Inscripta provides high-performance dictation and transcription solutions. Developed Java/Spring Boot backend and React frontends for transcription tools. Built Electron and React Native clients for desktop and mobile. Implemented WebRTC for real-time audio input/output in Node.js and web. Used DraftJS to create dynamic, interactive text editing experiences.
